title: PhysxAutoDeformableMeshSimplificationAPI
summary: Parameters for simplifying, and optionally first remeshing, the cooking source mesh during the automatic cook of a volume or surface deformable. Read only when the body also lists PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI; without this API the cook uses the source mesh as is.
producer_scope: Published like any applied physics API: every declared attribute at its resolved value. No column is rewritten or created by the producer.

columns.name: physxDeformableBody:autoDeformableMeshSimplificationEnabled
columns.absent: false: no simplification, the cooking source mesh is used as is (a volume body then always uses the conforming tetrahedral mesher). USD's fallback is true, so write the value.
columns.notes: A cooking input only: a change resyncs the deformable body and is one of the cooker's recook triggers.

columns.name: physxDeformableBody:forceConforming
columns.absent: false: with simplification on, a volume body uses the tree-based tetrahedral mesher; true selects the conforming mesher. Ignored without simplification (the conforming mesher is then always used) and for a surface body.
columns.notes: A cooking input only: a change resyncs the deformable body and is one of the cooker's recook triggers.

columns.name: physxDeformableBody:remeshingEnabled
columns.absent: false: simplification works on the source mesh directly, without remeshing it first. USD's fallback is true, so write the value. Used only with simplification on.
columns.notes: A cooking input only: a change resyncs the deformable body and is one of the cooker's recook triggers.

columns.name: physxDeformableBody:remeshingResolution
columns.absent: 0: automatic, the target resolution (longest bounds edge over the average source edge length, or the hexahedral resolution) clamped to [100, 250]. Used only with remeshing on.
columns.notes: A cooking input only: a change resyncs the deformable body and is one of the cooker's recook triggers.

columns.name: physxDeformableBody:targetTriangleCount
columns.absent: 0: automatic, 5 x source surface area / target edge length^2 + 1. Used only with simplification on.
columns.notes: A cooking input only: a change resyncs the deformable body and is one of the cooker's recook triggers.

interactions.rule: Read only inside the PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI read, for volume and surface bodies alike.
